audience_briefs.technical_reviewer:
# Architecture Review: 65+ Engine Autonomous Python System

SolarPunk implements a self-healing, self-modifying multi-agent Python system running on GitHub Actions. All engines in mycelium/, state in data/*.json, orchestration via ARCHITECT.py.

## Key Facts
- Architecture: ARCHITECT.py → AUTO_RUNNER.py → 65+ domain engines
- Self-healing: nanobot_repair.py patches broken engines automatically
- Self-modifying: UPGRADE_ENGINE.py rewrites engines from performance data
- Zero external dependencies for core operation (stdlib only)
- Full state serialization to JSON for audit and replay

## Action
Clone and run: git clone github.com/mrmosho/solarpunk && python mycelium/AUTO_RUNNER.py
